name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.167.0 — A mock-page note can now mark an area: drag a rectangle over any part of a served mock and the note lands on that content at every viewport width, painted in its status colour by the notes layer. The box is stored as a fraction of the smallest element containing it with the covered children as the reflow fallback, so it re-finds its spot or honestly reports itself outdated and offers re-placement. The owner's card beside the box carries accept, reject with a reason, resolve, withdraw and delete behind an undoable toast. 7.166.0 — A whole-product note now blocks the final sign-off instead of every journey. A journey's approve control counts only the questions and notes raised on that journey's own screens, so a product-wide doubt no longer makes every journey unapprovable; when a journey is clean while product-wide notes remain, the review page says how many still block sign-off, and `--mark approved` refuses by name until they are answered. Recorded as ADR-0019. 7.165.0 — The journey review page answers to a design: design/chrome-mocks/review.html is the binding reference artifact, cited as design_source. The rail's Whole project count is derived server-side instead of looked up in a map that could never hold it, so the first paint, a ?clean render and a capture all carry the number the browser re-derives. The scope band states its scope as real DOM text rather than CSS generated content, five .rv-* utilities win back the cascade from the generic .rv button rule, and the composer's dead scope toggle is deleted. Tests pin the page again, this time opt-in so they outlive the spec's close.
